subject.why: The arched footbridge railing with colourful heart-shaped padlocks and the large central golden padlock is clearly recognisable and complete.

category.why: The object is placed in a suitable outdoor setting with a clean water strip at the bottom and a simple gradient sky with soft cumulus clouds above.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, frame, watermark, or characters.

framing.why: The bridge cuts off abruptly on the left and right sides, and the railing scrolls crowd the lateral edges instead of having clear margins on both sides.

colour.why: The palette is bright, juicy, and saturated, with the colourful locks popping clearly against the blue sky.

detail.why: Forms are chunky and stylized with no micro-textures or extraneous clutter.

style.why: The smooth volumes, satin sheen, and clean rendering match the reference art style perfectly.

fix: Scale down the footbridge slightly so the ends are fully visible and clear side margins are preserved instead of cutting off at the left and right edges.
